attention.title: Battlecard relies on intel tools new here
attention.detail: `list_intel`, `get_intel` and the battlecard option on `get_entity` appear nowhere else in the repo or in the README tool list. The method only covers empty results. It doesn't say what to do if the server lacks these tools. Can the author confirm they ship today, or that they arrive with octave-app#8914?

attention.title: Five changed skills not yet run
attention.detail: The description says one-pager, microsite, ads, abm's cohort plan and prospector's lookalike route were not run to completion after the change. It says the last two are new behavior and should be run before release. No automated check covers skill prose.

attention.title: Contact rows still have no score
attention.detail: The fix added a score to account rows only. The lookalike method qualifies every person candidate, and the task method says to give the score on every row and rank by it. Contact rows have no score field, and their qualification is optional. A later step that ranks or filters contacts from the data loses the person score. Ask whether contacts should carry a required score and qualification.

attention.title: Seed customer names now ride in data rows
attention.detail: The method says seed customers are named only in the internal summary. Now every lookalike account and contact row names its seed in resembles, inside data built so a later step can act on the rows without reading the document. Outreach steps such as generate get the customer name, and only a description note keeps it out of copy. Ask whether downstream consumers drop resembles, or whether it…

attention.title: Seed fields optional and missing from data guide
attention.detail: resembles and matchedTraits are not required, unlike the other row fields, which must always be present, even as null. The data paragraph the run follows when it returns data doesn't list them either; only the lookalike method does. A lookalike row can leave them out, and a reader can't tell that from a row on another route. matchedTraits must also be 'as the tool reported them'. Can the author…

attention.title: Release and sync now gate on catalog fields
attention.detail: The validator now fails on an unknown kind, pillar or output id, a malformed about list, or a changelog whose first entry isn't the current version. It gates the release ZIP and the downstream sync. The Codex and Cursor builds carry no catalog, so only the root run checks these rules.
